caption:
Three ways to listen

I used to fix everything a friend told me. Then I started saying go on.

People who vent often want company in the problem more than a solution, and a short go on tends to give them that.

For whoever lets the other person keep talking.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table and a royal blue figure that says rough day. in each of three labeled scenes. The nodder: a teal figure stares at a phone and mutters mm-hm. The fixer: a brown figure says just quit. and the blue one looks down. The stayer: an ink-black figure leans toward the blue one and says go on., and the blue one's eyes turn happy. The text stays: three kinds of listening. The last card: Choose friction.
